name: Sidereal-Firth
description: There is no surface, only an endless fall through banded clouds: amber belts, cream zones, and storms wide enough to swallow worlds. Lightning flickers between the layers like thoughts of a vast mind.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
